consumer: An on-person possession check asking 'is the detonator carried on the player's body?', not a find-item mission over reachable inventory.
scope: On-person only (worn/wielded/carried inventory), excluding nearby crates, adjacent tiles, and other crafting-reachable sources.
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) queries u.crafting_inventory().has_amount/has_charges, a reachable-inventory predicate that pulls in surrounding/adjacent sources beyond the body.
divergence: A detonator sitting in an open crate on a tile adjacent to the player but not carried: crafting_inventory().has_amount returns true, yet the on-body goal should report false.
